items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private. Evidence: official API documentation establishes access mechanics only; current public terms do not establish rights to store, transform, cache, publicly display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, or monetize returned data. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, 10 unknown. Analytics is yellow with source-permission gaps. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission. Do not claim certification, ROI, margin, causal lift, or site-attributed revenue. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only where existing consent, cookie and analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, claims substantiation, provenance and rights, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and applicable age-sensitive safeguards are preserved.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial evidence exists for official API documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms; no task is closable. Open tasks remain source rights, alert-data retention and workflows, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source fields, provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep external outreach unsent and preserve the private gate.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data = counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; caching, display, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising limits. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional privacy review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.
